reviews.text: first class place. we love it!

After almost nine years, I’m finally taking my dog’s care elsewhere. I expected compassion and a willingness to find solutions, not to be dismissed with “its protocol”. The front desk manager didn’t help manage a solution. The care from the doctors had always been lovely, but it takes a whole team. They don’t have it anymore.

In the last two months, I have twice needed the clinic on a Saturday, only to be told there was no doctor on staff, despite the clinic advertising Saturday hours.

The final straw was my experience today. After my dog experienced an unusual episode of diarrhea over the weekend, I brought in a fecal sample as a precaution. With travel approaching and limited time before leaving the city with my dog, I was simply trying to be proactive and rule out a potential issue. She was doing great after a weekend of an upset tummy. Also, we were just there a month ago when the main doctor said she was ‘perfect’, so she had been seen recently.

What makes this particularly disappointing is that, over nearly nine years, I have consistently followed the clinic’s recommendations, completed the suggested tests, and purchased my dog’s food through them. I trusted this clinic with her care and always did what was asked of me.

To be met with such a rigid, unsympathetic response when trying to look after my dog was both heartbreaking and deeply disappointing. Good veterinary service should be about more than protocol; it should include compassion, communication, and a genuine willingness to help clients find solutions when their pets need care.

I called another vet in the area, had no problem sending in the lab test and I had no relationship with the clinic. They were more caring than Queen West where I had been for years!

Unfortunately, this experience has completely eroded my confidence in Queen West Animal Hospital, and I will be taking my dog elsewhere.
Everyone here is super lovely and accommodating. Super welcoming staff as well!

It’s always a good sign when you have to pull your dog out of the vet because he was so happy with his visit. Everyone was super sweet and welcoming, as a new adopted puppy it meant a lot to me that everyone was so nice and the interactions afterwards make me know that clearly my dog is getting the best care.
A fantastic place with caring animal lovers. Brought my cat in for her yearly checkup and the staff was friendly, answered all of my questions and treated my cat with care. Highly recommended
Amazing support, they were able to accommodate my cat on an emergency basis. Super grateful 🙌🙏 …

Thank you for your wonderful feedback and 5-star rating, Do!

Have a great day,
Queen West Animal Hospital

I’ve been with QWAH for 11 years now and they are awesome. They always check in on my girl when she’s not her best and Dr. Ng is the personable, funny and deeply cares for her patients! They are thorough and check all angles of my dog’s health.

HI Walter,

We greatly appreciate your 4-star rating, and your support of Queen West Animal Hospital!

All the best,
Queen West Animal Hospital
